description: Search the Data.gov catalog (300,000+ US federal, state and local open datasets): title, publisher and organisation, description, keywords, themes, access level, last modified and issued dates, whether a download exists, and each distribution (title, format/media type, download or access URL), plus the dataset page URL. Results come in relevance order; pass the returned next cursor to get the following page. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

after.description: Cursor from a previous answer's next field, for the next page

q.description: Search words, e.g. water quality, crime, census tracts (required)
